units.source_text: 车中人并不立刻下车，先叫人向老尼弁君探问情况：

en.t: The person in the carriage did not get out at once, but first sent someone to ask the old nun Ben no Kimi about the situation:

units.source_text: “听说有一位贵人住在这里，不知是谁。”

en.t: I hear that a noble person is staying here, but I do not know who it is.

units.source_text: 薰大将刚才闻知车中是此人之后，就预先告诫众人：

en.t: After General Kaoru had just learned who was in the carriage, he had warned everyone in advance:

units.source_text: “决不可告诉他们我住在这里！”

en.t: You must absolutely not tell them that I am staying here!

units.source_text: 因此侍女们都会意，答道：

en.t: So the serving women all understood his meaning and replied:

units.source_text: “请小姐快快下车吧。

en.t: Please, my lady, hurry and get down from the carriage.

units.source_text: 这里原有一位客人，但他是住在那边的。”

en.t: There is indeed a guest here, but he is staying over there.

units.source_text: 同乘的一个青年侍女先下了车，把车上的帘子揭起。

en.t: A young serving woman who had ridden with her got down first and lifted the carriage curtain.

units.source_text: 这青年侍女不像那些随从人的乡村气，看上去很顺眼。

en.t: This young serving woman did not have the rustic air of the attendants, and she was quite pleasant to look at.

units.source_text: 又有一个年纪较大的侍女下车，对车中人说：

en.t: Then an older serving woman got down and said to the person in the carriage:

units.source_text: “请快下车。”

en.t: Please get down quickly.

units.source_text: 车中人答道：

en.t: The person in the carriage answered:

units.source_text: “这里似乎有人看见的。”

en.t: It seems someone here can see me.

units.source_text: 这声音微弱而文雅。

en.t: Her voice was faint and refined.

units.source_text: 那年纪较大的侍女用老练的口气说：

en.t: The older serving woman said in a practiced tone:

units.source_text: “您总是说这样的话。

en.t: You are always saying such things.

units.source_text: 这里一向是关上窗子的。

en.t: The windows here are always kept shut.

units.source_text: 这种地方，哪里有人看见呢？”

en.t: In a place like this, who could possibly see you?

units.source_text: 车中人便小心翼翼地走下车来。

en.t: The person in the carriage then stepped down very cautiously.

units.source_text: 但见其人头面和身材都很小巧优雅，薰大将一看就回想起大女公子来。

en.t: Her face and figure were both delicate and graceful, and the moment General Kaoru saw her, he was reminded of the elder princess.

units.source_text: 她用扇子遮住脸，薰大将看不见她的颜貌，很焦急。

en.t: She covered her face with a fan, so General Kaoru could not see her features and grew very impatient.

units.source_text: 他一边注视着，一边心头扑通扑通地乱跳。

en.t: As he watched her, his heart thumped wildly.

units.source_text: 车子很高，而下车的地方很低。

en.t: The carriage was high, while the place where she had to step down was low.

units.source_text: 两个侍女若无其事地跨了下来，但这位女主人下车时颇感困难，她东看西看，许久才下了车，立刻膝行进入室内去了。

en.t: The two serving women stepped down as if it were nothing, but their mistress found it rather difficult; after looking this way and that, she finally got down after a long while and immediately shuffled on her knees into the room.

units.source_text: 她身穿深红色褂子，外罩暗红面蓝里子的常礼服和浅绿色的小礼服。

en.t: She wore a deep crimson robe, with formal robes over it that had a dark red outer face and blue lining, together with a pale green smaller robe.

units.source_text: 她室中的纸隔扇边立着一个四尺高的屏风。

en.t: Beside the paper sliding screen in her room stood a folding screen about four feet high.

units.source_text: 但薰大将窥探的那个洞隙位在高处，所以完全看得清楚。

en.t: But the gap through which General Kaoru was peering was high up, so he could see everything clearly.

units.source_text: 这位浮舟小姐担心邻室有人窥看，把脸向着那边，斜倚着躺在那里。

en.t: Lady Ukifune, worried that someone in the next room might be watching, turned her face that way and lay there leaning at an angle.

units.source_text: 两个侍女毫无疲劳之色，相与谈话：

en.t: The two serving women showed no sign of fatigue and talked with each other:

units.source_text: “小姐今天累得很了！

en.t: My lady must be very tired today!

units.source_text: 木津川中的渡船，二月里水浅的时候很平稳，但今天水涨，的确很可怕。

en.t: The ferry on the Kizu River is very calm in the second month when the water is shallow, but today the water had risen, and it was truly frightening.

units.source_text: 不过其实算得了什么呢！

en.t: But really, what did that amount to?

units.source_text: 想想我们东国的旅行，这里哪有可怕的地方！”

en.t: When we think of our journey in the eastern provinces, there is nothing frightening here at all!

units.source_text: 小姐一言不发，默默地躺着。

en.t: The young lady said not a word and lay there silently.

units.source_text: 她露出的手臂，圆肥可爱。

en.t: The arm she had exposed was plump, round, and charming.

units.source_text: 此人全不像是身份低微的常陆守的女儿，实在是一位高贵的千金小姐。

en.t: She did not look at all like the daughter of the low-ranking Governor of Hitachi, but truly seemed to be a noble young lady of high birth.
